scope: Theorem 3.1 (Tree covering) of the manuscript “The second Kahn–Kalai conjecture” (preprints/The-second-Kahn-Kalai-conjecture-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 176 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dd0c26b99de9e1d0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let T be a disjoint probability tree on a finite set X, with k ≥ 1 levels. Suppose that every level is σ-spread, where σ > 0, and that its positive integer capacities satisfy ℓi+1 ≥ 16ℓi (1 ≤ i < k). Set r = min{1, 16e50 σ(1 + log2 ℓk)}. Then PW∼µr U(P) ⊆ W for some path P of T  ≥ 2 3.
